key_insight: Quantum Enhanced Graph Decomposition (QEGD) uses QAOA-guided local vertex merging to simplify MaxCut graphs and improve solution quality in the reported tests.
engineering_relevance: QEGD offers a way to reduce graph size before QAOA optimization, with reported average wall-clock times of 0.4%–5% of DC-QAOA’s.
method: Use QAOA as a subroutine to guide local vertex merging.
Sparsify the MaxCut graph through these merges.
Solve the reduced problem using QAOA.
evidence_signal: QEGD outperformed GDOA on tested random 5- and 6-regular graphs, exceeded QAOA² and ParaQAOA in average approximation ratio on tested Erdős–Rényi graphs, and beat DC-QAOA on sparse graphs while remaining comparable on denser ones.
watch_item: QEGD is a heuristic; the abstract does not establish optimality guarantees or performance on quantum hardware.
